review_locator: PMCID:PMC2846745, Eosinophil Survival and Apoptosis in Health and Disease
primary_title: Analysis of the survival of mature human eosinophils: interleukin-5 prevents apoptosis in mature human eosinophils
decision_basis: The review identifies IL-5 as a major eosinophil survival factor; the cited primary shows recombinant IL-5 maintains mature human eosinophil viability and prevents apoptosis during cytokine-supported culture.
limitations_preserved: IL-5-supported survival is an in-vitro mature-eosinophil output; do not infer a single anti-apoptotic gene, developmental-stage equivalence, or SCI transfer.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC59571, Th2 cytokines and asthma — The role of interleukin-5 in allergic eosinophilic disease
primary_title: Release of granule proteins from eosinophils cultured with IL-5
decision_basis: The review cites primary evidence that IL-5-conditioned human eosinophils release eosinophil-derived neurotoxin and degranulate more readily; the primary measures EDN loss into culture medium and enhanced release after secondary secretory-IgA/IgG stimulation.
limitations_preserved: IL-5 conditioning supports EDN release and secondary-stimulus degranulation; preserve the culture duration and IgA/IgG-bead context and do not represent IL-5 as the only degranulation trigger.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC59571, Th2 cytokines and asthma — The role of interleukin-5 in allergic eosinophilic disease
primary_title: Release of granule proteins from eosinophils cultured with IL-5
decision_basis: The review cites primary evidence that IL-5-conditioned human eosinophils release eosinophil cationic protein; the primary measures loss of ECP into culture medium during IL-5 exposure.
limitations_preserved: IL-5-conditioned eosinophils release ECP in the cited culture; preserve the prolonged-culture/activation context and do not infer a direct receptor-to-granule exocytosis mechanism.
